title: Course final status
description: Course-level final-status enum produced by the promotion-chain aggregator (Wave 3 G1) and stamped onto LibV2/courses/<slug>/manifest.json::quality_metadata.final_status. The enum is compositional: each value declares progressively stricter coverage requirements (accessible ⊂ instructional ⊂ trainable). 'failed' and 'non_certified_archive' are terminal.
